bodyHtml:
Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world. Start your journey to multisensory perception HERE.

In this deeply intimate continuation of his journey, Gary Zukav reveals what happens when the boundaries between physical and non-physical reality begin to dissolve. Through his ongoing Spiritual Partnership with Linda Francis after her Soul’s transition, Gary guides listeners through the paradox of profound presence and profound loss existing simultaneously. He shares the bewildering terrain of speaking with Linda daily while also aching for her physical touch – the five-sensory longing to hear her laugh. This is not a story of “getting over” grief; it is a testament to expanding beyond the personality’s limitations to discover a connection that transcends the Earth School’s physical constraints.

The confusion Gary describes is not weakness – it is the natural friction that occurs when frightened parts of the personality demand the world remain as it was, while loving parts recognize a deeper intimacy emerging. His teacher’s instruction seemed impossible: forget about missing Linda and enjoy life. Yet this paradox held the key to Authentic Power.

The pain of the personality can coexist with the reality of the Soul’s presence, and the intellect – designed only for five-sensory perception – cannot reconcile what the heart already knows.

The solution Gary discovered was a Responsible Choice: to experience greater intimacy with Linda, he had to stop clinging to the old forms of their relationship. By setting the intention to relax into joy, he created space for a multisensory connection to emerge – one where Linda appears in morning light, in clouds, and in moments of presence so powerful they fill every cell of his being. This is the promise of multisensory perception: not the loss of those we love, but an expansion into experiencing them in ways the five senses alone could never access.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (00:02) — The Vast Scope of Human Emotion: Gary explores the full range of emotional experience—from rage and victimhood to gratitude and awe—and why you are far more than any single snapshot of feeling.
  • (04:15) — Choosing Between Love and Fear: How the new consciousness gives you the unprecedented ability to distinguish frightened parts of your personality from loving parts, and to make the Responsible Choice of which to act on.
  • (06:50) — “Linda Is With You”: The first words Gary’s teacher spoke after Linda’s Soul’s transition, and why frightened parts of the personality demand the world remain unchanged while love opens to new possibilities.
  • (11:03) — Forgetting About Missing Her: The paradoxical instruction to “forget about missing Linda and enjoy life”—and how setting this intention opened the door to experiencing her multisensory presence more fully.
  • (14:34) — Seeing Linda in Everything: Gary describes the first time he saw Linda in the morning light through trees, in clouds, and felt her presence so powerfully it filled his entire being.
  • (18:14) — Beyond the Intellect’s Limits: Why the intellect was never designed to understand non-physical reality, and how the new consciousness allows you to become what you are rather than just describe it.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Think of someone you have navigated a transition with – whether through a Soul’s transition, distance, or the shifting forms of a relationship – and recall a moment when you felt their multisensory presence in an unexpected way. Perhaps in nature, in a sudden knowing, or in a feeling that filled you without explanation.

Pause and ask yourself: What if that presence was real? What if the way you have been taught to understand connection is only a limited form of five-sensory perception? What if there are intimacies available to you now that you could not access before? Gently invite yourself to consider that those you love may be closer than your five senses can perceive, waiting for you to make the Responsible Choice to relax into a new way of experiencing their presence.
